notes: Could not fetch live FHL API data — SN tags reconstructed from known Hebrew source (BHS) for Gen 1:17. Confidence lowered accordingly.
UNV 就 has no SN equivalent — left unannotated in LCC (上帝 absorbs H0430 which appears at verse level).
H0853 (אֹתָם/them): LCC has '這些發光之體' which is explicit, but the direct object marker itself has no Chinese word — kept as implicit {<WH0853>} after the noun phrase.
LCC '讓它們照' maps to UNV '普照' — the infinitive construct לְהָאִיר gets H0215 with lamed prefix H09001.

H8064 (שָׁמָיִם/heavens) — UNV has 天空 but LCC uses 天穹 (firmament); the SN for heavens may belong on the implied 'of heaven' genitive. Placed H7549 on 天穹 as it maps to רָקִיעַ (firmament/expanse), but H8064 may be implicit here since LCC omits a separate word for 'heavens'. This is the main source of uncertainty.
Morphology: H8799 (Qal Imperfect wayyiqtol for נָתַן), H8687 (Hiphil Infinitive construct for אוֹר). These are approximate without live API verification.
